description: List invoices, filterable by client and payment status (paid / unpaid / overdue). status_id on each invoice: 1 draft, 2 sent, 3 partial, 4 paid, 5 cancelled, 6 reversed. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices.

client_id.description: Only records for this client (hashed id).

client_status.description: Comma-separated payment status: all, paid, unpaid, overdue.

filter.description: Free-text search across number, PO number, date, amount, balance, client name/contacts and line items.

number.description: Only the invoice with this number.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

name: invoiceninja_list_invoices
title: List invoices
